MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL
          THEN date_diff('year', strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), DATE('2026-10-15'))
          ELSE date_diff('year', strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), strptime(p.death_date, '%Y/%m/%d'))
     END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
     CAST(date_part('year', strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(date_part('month', strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(date_part('day', strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')) AS INT64) AS birth_day,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 2026 ELSE CAST(date_part('year', strptime(p.death_date, '%Y/%m/%d')) AS INT64) END AS end_year,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE CAST(date_part('month', strptime(p.death_date, '%Y/%m/%d')) AS INT64) END AS end_month,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 15 ELSE CAST(date_part('day', strptime(p.death_date, '%Y/%m/%d')) AS INT64) END AS end_day
WITH p,
     end_year - birth_year - CASE WHEN end_month < birth_month OR (end_month = birth_month AND end_day < birth_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ',', 2)) AS INT64) END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) ELSE CASE LOWER(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1)) WHEN 'january' THEN 1 WHEN 'jan' THEN 1 WHEN 'february' THEN 2 WHEN 'feb' THEN 2 WHEN 'march' THEN 3 WHEN 'mar' THEN 3 WHEN 'april' THEN 4 WHEN 'apr' THEN 4 WHEN 'may' THEN 5 WHEN 'june' THEN 6 WHEN 'jun' THEN 6 WHEN 'july' THEN 7 WHEN 'jul' THEN 7 WHEN 'august' THEN 8 WHEN 'aug' THEN 8 WHEN 'september' THEN 9 WHEN 'sep' THEN 9 WHEN 'sept' THEN 9 WHEN 'october' THEN 10 WHEN 'oct' THEN 10 WHEN 'november' THEN 11 WHEN 'nov' THEN 11 WHEN 'december' THEN 12 WHEN 'dec' THEN 12 END END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', '') AS INT64) END AS birth_day,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 2026 ELSE CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.death_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.death_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(p.death_date, ',', 2)) AS INT64) END END AS end_year,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.death_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.death_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) ELSE 10 END END AS end_month,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 15 ELSE CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.death_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.death_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE 15 END END AS end_day
WITH p, end_year - birth_year - CASE WHEN end_month < birth_month OR (end_month = birth_month AND end_day < birth_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
